lines.text: The word of the LORD came to Zephaniah son of Cushi in the days of Josiah king of Judah.
The LORD will stretch out His hand against Judah and Jerusalem, against those who swear by the LORD and by Chemosh.
The Day of the LORD is near, and the LORD will punish the princes and the sons of the king.
A cry will go up from the Gate of Ephraim, and the LORD will search Jerusalem with lamps.
Neither their silver nor their gold will deliver them on the Day of the LORD's wrath.
